preservation: All 173 inherited core modules, inherited Python sources, appendices and both bibliographies are byte-preserved. The complete v76 journal source is retained at provenance/v76-main.tex and assembled into the supplement. No earlier paper directory, report or branch is changed.
source_assembly: The inherited v76 assembler retains all mathematics through v75. The new assembler inserts the complete v76 abstract and body and its three modules. The supplement compiles 173 inherited modules; the journal compiles three new modules.
field_scope: The field is specified by XL=1 and X theta=0, theta=arg(-p0,pm), on the complete regular exact event. Its endpoint Hessian and forward motion estimates are uniform in collision count. It needs no critical collars or auxiliary caps. Uniform lifetime through true boundaries and weighted third-derivative control are not asserted.
recoupling_scope: The maximal coupling preserves one fixed exact label and the physical endpoint-momentum angle. It may pair different actual words. Its defect is at most the forward stopped-flow defect for the specified field, not asserted smaller than every two-sided scalar or arbitrary-field modulus.
current_scope: The signed angular roof derivative is a finite measure at fixed m. The threshold argument gives finite N_m, J_m and C_m, with no collision-normalized concentration bound. True boundary flux is retained before signed cancellation and Jordan decomposition.
limit_order: Fix B, epsilon(B), r(B), and all auxiliary bands before collision limsup; enlarge auxiliary band afterwards, and B last. No collision-dependent Fourier band, guard alteration, label pooling or zero-class normalization.
qualification_scope: Exact-SHA preservation, finite normal/optimized fixtures, full native journal and 173-core supplement, actual 176-core recorder coverage, stable warning-free references and page geometry. These are not mathematical certification.
